pages: Ewan Rigg, a boy of thirteen with sandy hair, wears a dark green knitted wool jumper with the cuffs turned back and sets one school exercise book on the hut table, a rubber band round its cover. Middle distance: a long-lens camera on a strap, a tin of slides. Background: corrugated iron and grey sea, morning light.

Ewan Rigg, sandy hair, dark green knitted wool jumper with cuffs turned back, rules one line down a sheet of the exercise book with a pencil. Middle distance: a barometer in a wooden case, a kettle on the stove, a box of slides on the sill. Background: corrugated iron wall and a small window, flat grey daylight.

Ewan Rigg, sandy hair, dark green knitted wool jumper with cuffs turned back, lifts one index card from a shallow card tray and holds it flat in his palm. Middle distance: a rubber-banded exercise book, a pencil, a tin lid of paperclips. Background: the hut window, wet kelp on the sill, grey daylight.

Ewan Rigg, sandy hair, dark green knitted wool jumper with cuffs turned back, writes one line down the exercise book with a pencil stub, counting as he goes. Middle distance: a card index tray, a barometer in its wooden case, a tin of slides. Background: corrugated iron wall and low sun on the sill, warm evening light.

Ewan Rigg, sandy hair, dark green knitted wool jumper with cuffs turned back, sights along one camera viewfinder, a long lens shouldered on a dog-collar strap. Middle distance: an open notebook on the rail, a lens cap in his fingers, a coil of rope. Background: open sea and a grey horizon, hard clear light.

Ewan Rigg, sandy hair, dark green knitted wool jumper with cuffs turned back, turns the focus ring of one long-lens camera with his fingertips, the lens over the rail. Middle distance: a wet notebook, a lens cap, a salt-bleached rail. Background: slate-green water and a distant white wake, bright daylight.

Ewan Rigg, sandy hair, dark green knitted wool jumper with cuffs turned back, stands at the hut window with one hand flat on the glass, a camera hanging at his chest. Middle distance: a tin of slides on the sill, a barometer, a hanging coat. Background: a whale's fluke held clear of the water, pale morning light.

Ewan Rigg, sandy hair, dark green knitted wool jumper with cuffs turned back, squares one black and white print on the bench with his fingertips. Middle distance: a card index tray, a pair of tweezers, a tin lid. Background: the hut window with flat daylight and dark sea beyond, still air.

Ewan Rigg, sandy hair, dark green knitted wool jumper with cuffs turned back, holds one black and white print up against the window pane in each hand. Middle distance: a card index tray, a small loupe, a pencil. Background: the window frame and blown-out daylight, grey sea beyond the sill.

Ewan Rigg, sandy hair, dark green knitted wool jumper with cuffs turned back, lays one slide flat on the bench and bends his face close over it. Middle distance: an open slide tin, a card index tray, a pencil. Background: the hut window and cool grey daylight, a dark swell outside.

Ewan Rigg, sandy hair, dark green knitted wool jumper with cuffs turned back, stands in the hut doorway with one hand on the door edge, a telephone wire running up the wall behind him. Middle distance: prints spread on the bench, a card index tray, a barometer. Background: grey daylight over the boat sheds, sea beyond.

Ewan Rigg, sandy hair, dark green knitted wool jumper with cuffs turned back, folds one sheet of paper into three and pushes it deep into his jumper pocket. Middle distance: a rubber-banded exercise book, a pencil, a card index tray. Background: the hut window and grey afternoon light, whitecaps below.

Ewan Rigg, sandy hair, dark green knitted wool jumper with cuffs turned back, slides one print across the bench against a second and squares their edges. Middle distance: two boxes of cards, a tin lid of clips, a pencil. Background: corrugated iron wall and low winter sun, a long shadow on the bench.

Ewan Rigg, sandy hair, dark green knitted wool jumper with cuffs turned back, writes one word on the back of an index card with a pencil. Middle distance: two boxes of cards, a stack of prints, a tin of slides. Background: the hut window and flat grey daylight, rain beading on the sill.

Ewan Rigg, sandy hair, dark green knitted wool jumper with cuffs turned back, squares one full tray of index cards under the window with both hands and taps it flat. Middle distance: a rubber-banded exercise book, a sharpened pencil, an eraser. Background: the window ledge and low sun over the water, evening gold.

Ewan Rigg, sandy hair, dark green knitted wool jumper with cuffs turned back, raises one long-lens camera to his eye, elbows down, the dog-collar strap across his palm. Middle distance: a card index tray on the rail, a lens cap, a wet notebook. Background: slate-green water and evening sun lying flat on the sea.

Ewan Rigg, sandy hair, dark green knitted wool jumper with cuffs turned back, writes one number on the back of an index card with a pencil, the tray open beside him. Middle distance: an exercise book, a tin lid, a sharpened pencil stub. Background: the hut window and last light on the water, dusk.

Ewan Rigg, sandy hair, dark green knitted wool jumper with cuffs turned back, slides one full card tray into a round tin and settles the lid on it. Middle distance: a rubber-banded exercise book, two rolled films, an enamel mug. Background: the window with dusk outside, water over the shingle.
